label: Civil Engineers
title: Construction Administration Software for Civil Engineers | CA-Vault
desc: Tender, compare bids, administer unit-price contracts and certify payment in one record. Construction administration software built for civil engineering teams.
h1: Construction Administration Software for Civil Engineers
job: Spend less time administering the contract.
lead: You designed the work. CA-Vault takes the administrative load of tendering it, comparing the bids and certifying payment on a unit-price contract.
cta: See CA-Vault for Civil Engineering Teams
ctaTitle: See a civil tender run from call to certificate.
painsTitle: Engineering hours spent on data entry

pains.d: Hundreds of unit prices from several bidders, keyed into a spreadsheet before you can even start the analysis.
Re-entering the contractor’s invoice to check quantities you already have on record.
RFI responses and change approvals that are hard to find when a claim arrives a year later.

workTitle: A unit-price contract, start to finish

workflow.d: Issue the schedule of prices and tender documents to bidders.
Review the generated bid comparison and export it for the owner.
Respond to RFIs, review submittals and manage changes on the contract.
Review progress invoices and issue payment certificates.

shotCaption: A civil works tender: bonding, site preparation, dust suppression and survey items compared across four bidders.
outcomes: Bid comparisons generated at tender close
Payment certificates produced from the contractor’s own invoice
One traceable record of RFIs, changes and approvals
proofTitle: Bids that arrive compliant and comparable
proofText: Engineering and consulting teams have used the platform to stop collecting PDF bids by email. This is how one bidding manager described the difference.

faq.q: Is CA-Vault suited to unit-price civil contracts?
faq.a: Yes. The platform is organised around the schedule of prices: items, quantities, units and unit rates. That structure runs from tender through to payment certification.

faq.q: Can we export the bid comparison for our client?
faq.a: Yes. The bid review can be exported to PDF or Excel.

faq.q: Do contractors need to buy CA-Vault to bid?
faq.a: No. Contractor invitations are unlimited and free for contractors on the Tender plan and above.

h1: Contract Administration Software for Landscape Architects
job: Show the client a clear bid comparison, then keep the contract tidy.

pains.d: Comparing contractors’ submitted bids for the client by entering every price manually.
Plant substitutions and field adjustments that need pricing, approval and a record.

The comparison is ready when the tender closes. Share it with the client.
Price, approve and sign changes as the site evolves.
Review invoices and issue certificates from the same line items.

Changes signed and filed with their evidence
Payment certification that is quick to review and reissue
proofTitle: Landscape architecture practices were early adopters

ContractComplete onboarding was typically a single session of under an hour. We will confirm the current CA-Vault onboarding process when you book a demo.

label: Consultants
title: Construction Contract Administration for Consultants | CA-Vault
desc: Administer construction contracts for your clients without building another administrative system to maintain. Bids, RFIs, changes and certificates in one record.
h1: Administer Projects Without Creating Another System to Manage
job: Administer the contract on the client’s behalf, with a record you can stand behind.
lead: As the party in the middle, you carry the record. CA-Vault gives owner, contractor and consultant one place to work so you are not the one reconciling everyone’s versions.
ctaTitle: See how the middle of the contract gets lighter.
painsTitle: The consultant becomes the filing system

pains.d: RFIs, submittals and invoices arrive in different formats from different people.

pains.t: Your spreadsheet is the source of truth
pains.d: Which means you maintain it, defend it and rebuild it for every project.
Forwarding items for review and chasing responses that affect the schedule.

workTitle: One queue for everything that needs you

workflow.d: RFIs, submittals and invoices arrive in your ActionBox.
Respond directly, or send items to sub-consultants for review.
Sign change orders and certify payments in the platform.
Show the owner contract status without assembling it by hand.

shotCaption: The RFI log for a contract, with due dates and response-time analytics.
outcomes: One queue instead of several inboxes
No duplicate entry between contractor and consultant
A defensible record when questions come later
proofTitle: No duplication between contractor and consultant
proofText: The biggest gain comes when both sides of the contract are in the same record. A consulting firm’s chief executive put it this way.

faq.q: Do our clients and contractors have to pay?
faq.a: Contractor invitations are unlimited and free for contractors on paid plans. Each plan includes a set number of users for your own team, with no per-seat add-ons.
Yes. Submittals can be forwarded to sub-consultants for their review.

faq.q: Can we use it on only one project to start?
faq.a: Yes. Plans are priced by users and locations, not per project, so you can start with one contract and add more.

title: Construction Administration Software for Contractors | CA-Vault

Raise RFIs with marked-up images and track the response.
